verses.en: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.pt: E entrando Jesus num barco, passou para o outro lado, e chegou à sua própria cidade.
verses.en_web: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.
verses.en_bbe: And he got into a boat and went across and came to his town.

verses.en: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.pt: E eis que lhe trouxeram um paralítico deitado num leito. Jesus, pois, vendo-lhes a fé, disse ao paralítico: Tem ânimo, filho; perdoados são os teus pecados.
verses.en_web: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
verses.en_bbe: And they took to him a man stretched on a bed who had no power of moving; and Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the man who was ill, Son, take heart; you have forgiveness for your sins.

verses.en: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
verses.pt: E alguns dos escribas disseram consigo: Este homem blasfema.
verses.en_web: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
verses.en_bbe: And some of the scribes said among themselves, This man has no respect for God.

verses.en: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.pt: Mas Jesus, conhecendo-lhes os pensamentos, disse: Por que pensais o mal em vossos corações?
verses.en_web: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, having knowledge of what was in their minds, said, Why are your thoughts evil?

verses.en: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.pt: Pois qual é mais fácil? dizer: Perdoados são os teus pecados, ou dizer: Levanta-te e anda?
verses.en_web: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk?’
verses.en_bbe: For which is the simpler, to say, You have forgiveness for your sins; or to say, Get up and go?

verses.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
verses.pt: Ora, para que saibais que o Filho do homem tem sobre a terra autoridade para perdoar pecados (disse então ao paralítico): Levanta- te, toma o teu leito, e vai para tua casa.
verses.en_web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins-” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
verses.en_bbe: But so that you may see that on earth the Son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins, (then said he to the man who was ill,) Get up, and take up your bed, and go to your house.

verses.en: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.pt: E este, levantando-se, foi para sua casa.
verses.en_web: He arose and departed to his house.
verses.en_bbe: And he got up and went away to his house.

verses.en: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
verses.pt: E as multidões, vendo isso, temeram, e glorificaram a Deus, que dera tal autoridade aos homens.
verses.en_web: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
verses.en_bbe: But when the people saw it they were full of fear, and gave glory to God who had given such authority to men.

verses.en: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.pt: Partindo Jesus dali, viu sentado na coletoria um homem chamado Mateus, e disse-lhe: Segue-me. E ele, levantando-se, o seguiu.
verses.en_web: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus was going from there, he saw a man whose name was Matthew, seated at the place where taxes were taken; and he said to him, Come after me. And he got up and went after him.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.pt: Ora, estando ele à mesa em casa, eis que chegaram muitos publicanos e pecadores, e se reclinaram à mesa juntamente com Jesus e seus discípulos.
verses.en_web: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about, when he was in the house taking food, that a number of tax-farmers and sinners came and took their places with Jesus and his disciples.

verses.en: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.pt: E os fariseus, vendo isso, perguntavam aos discípulos: Por que come o vosso Mestre com publicanos e pecadores?
verses.en_web: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
verses.en_bbe: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, Why does your Master take food with tax-farmers and sinners?

verses.en: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, ouvindo isso, respondeu: Não necessitam de médico os sãos, mas sim os enfermos.
verses.en_web: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
verses.en_bbe: But on hearing this he said, Those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill.

verses.en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.pt: Ide, pois, e aprendei o que significa: Misericórdia quero, e não sacrifícios. Porque eu não vim chamar justos, mas pecadores.
verses.en_web: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
verses.en_bbe: But go and take to heart the sense of these words, My desire is for mercy, not offerings: for I have come not to get the upright, but sinners.

verses.en: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.pt: Então vieram ter com ele os discípulos de João, perguntando: Por que é que nós e os fariseus jejuamos, mas os teus discípulos não jejuam?
verses.en_web: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the disciples of John came to him, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees frequently go without food, but your disciples do not?

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Podem porventura ficar tristes os convidados às núpcias, enquanto o noivo está com eles? Dias virão, porém, em que lhes será tirado o noivo, e então hão de jejuar.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to them, Will the friends of the newly-married man be sad as long as he is with them? But the days will come when he will be taken away from them, and then will they go without food.

verses.en: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
verses.pt: Ninguém põe remendo de pano novo em vestido velho; porque semelhante remendo tira parte do vestido, e faz-se maior a rotura.
verses.en_web: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
verses.en_bbe: And no man puts a bit of new cloth on an old coat, for by pulling away from the old, it makes a worse hole.

verses.en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
verses.pt: Nem se deita vinho novo em odres velhos; do contrário se rebentam, derrama-se o vinho, e os odres se perdem; mas deita-se vinho novo em odres novos, e assim ambos se conservam.
verses.en_web: Neither do people put new wine into old wine skins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wine skins, and both are preserved.”
verses.en_bbe: And men do not put new wine into old wine-skins; or the skins will be burst and the wine will come out, and the skins are of no more use: but they put new wine into new wine-skins, and so the two will be safe.

verses.en: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.pt: Enquanto ainda lhes dizia essas coisas, eis que chegou um chefe da sinagoga e o adorou, dizendo: Minha filha acaba de falecer; mas vem, impõe-lhe a tua mão, e ela viverá.
verses.en_web: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
verses.en_bbe: While he was saying these things to them, there came a ruler and gave him worship, saying, My daughter is even now dead; but come and put your hand on her, and she will come back to life.

verses.en: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
verses.pt: Levantou-se, pois, Jesus, e o foi seguindo, ele e os seus discípulos.
verses.en_web: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus got up and went after him, and so did his disciples.

verses.en: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.pt: E eis que certa mulher, que havia doze anos padecia de uma hemorragia, chegou por detrás dele e tocou-lhe a orla do manto;
verses.en_web: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
verses.en_bbe: And a woman, who for twelve years had had a flow of blood, came after him, and put her hand on the edge of his robe:

verses.en: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.pt: porque dizia consigo: Se eu tão-somente tocar-lhe o manto, ficarei sã.
verses.en_web: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
verses.en_bbe: Because, she said to herself, if I may but put my hand on his robe, I will be made well.

verses.en: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus, voltando-se e vendo-a, disse: Tem ânimo, filha, a tua fé te salvou. E desde aquela hora a mulher ficou sã.
verses.en_web: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus, turning and seeing her, said, Daughter, take heart; your faith has made you well. And the woman was made well from that hour.

verses.en: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.pt: Quando Jesus chegou à casa daquele chefe, e viu os tocadores de flauta e a multidão em alvoroço,
verses.en_web: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house and saw the players with their instruments and the people making a noise,

verses.en: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.pt: disse; Retirai-vos; porque a menina não está morta, mas dorme. E riam-se dele.
verses.en_web: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
verses.en_bbe: He said, Make room; for the girl is not dead, but sleeping. And they were laughing at him.

verses.en: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.pt: Tendo-se feito sair o povo, entrou Jesus, tomou a menina pela mão, e ela se levantou.
verses.en_web: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
verses.en_bbe: But when the people were sent out, he went in and took her by the hand; and the girl got up.

verses.en: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
verses.pt: E espalhou-se a notícia disso por toda aquela terra.
verses.en_web: The report of this went out into all that land.
verses.en_bbe: And the news of it went out into all that land.

verses.en: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
verses.pt: Partindo Jesus dali, seguiram-no dois cegos, que clamavam, dizendo: Tem compaixão de nós, Filho de Davi.
verses.en_web: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus went on from there, two blind men came after him, crying out, Have mercy on us, you Son of David.

verses.en: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.pt: E, tendo ele entrado em casa, os cegos se aproximaram dele; e Jesus perguntou-lhes: Credes que eu posso fazer isto? Responderam- lhe eles: Sim, Senhor.
verses.en_web: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.en_bbe: And when he had come into the house, the blind men came to him; and Jesus said to them, Have you faith that I am able to do this? They said to him, Yes, Lord.

verses.en: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.pt: Então lhes tocou os olhos, dizendo: Seja-vos feito segundo a vossa fé.
verses.en_web: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he put his hand on their eyes, saying, As your faith is, let it be done to you.

verses.en: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
verses.pt: E os olhos se lhes abriram. Jesus ordenou-lhes terminantemente, dizendo: Vede que ninguém o saiba.
verses.en_web: Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
verses.en_bbe: And their eyes were made open. And Jesus said to them sharply, Let no man have knowledge of it.

verses.en: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.pt: Eles, porém, saíram, e divulgaram a sua fama por toda aquela terra.
verses.en_web: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
verses.en_bbe: But they went out and gave news of him in all that land.

verses.en: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.pt: Enquanto esses se retiravam, eis que lhe trouxeram um homem mudo e endemoninhado.
verses.en_web: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
verses.en_bbe: And while they were going away, there came to him a man without the power of talking, and with an evil spirit.

verses.en: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
verses.pt: E, expulso o demônio, falou o mudo e as multidões se admiraram, dizendo: Nunca tal se viu em Israel.
verses.en_web: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
verses.en_bbe: And when the evil spirit had been sent out, the man had the power of talking: and they were all surprised, saying, Such a thing has never been seen in Israel.

verses.en: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.pt: Os fariseus, porém, diziam: É pelo príncipe dos demônios que ele expulsa os demônios.
verses.en_web: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
verses.en_bbe: But the Pharisees said, By the ruler of evil spirits, he sends evil spirits out of men.

verses.en: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.pt: E percorria Jesus todas as cidades e aldeias, ensinando nas sinagogas, pregando o evangelho do reino, e curando toda sorte de doenças e enfermidades.
verses.en_web: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus went about all the towns and small places, teaching in their Synagogues and preaching the good news of the kingdom and making well all sorts of disease and pain.

verses.en: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
verses.pt: Vendo ele as multidões, compadeceu-se delas, porque andavam desgarradas e errantes, como ovelhas que não têm pastor.
verses.en_web: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
verses.en_bbe: But when he saw all the people he was moved with pity for them, because they were troubled and wandering like sheep without a keeper.

verses.en: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
verses.pt: Então disse a seus discípulos: Na verdade, a seara é grande, mas os trabalhadores são poucos.
verses.en_web: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to his disciples, There is much grain but not enough men to get it in.

verses.en: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.pt: Rogai, pois, ao Senhor da seara que mande trabalhadores para a sua seara.
verses.en_web: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
verses.en_bbe: Make prayer, then, to the Lord of the grain-fields, that he may send out workers to get in his grain.
